method: Assistant visual annotations on native 1920x1080 frames; approximate to 3 pixels. Development footage, not surveyed ground truth. Paint intersections were not provided to the automatic fitter. Endpoint foot points mark the lowest visible shoe of red-shirt track 23. Crops at ten-frame intervals were reviewed for identity only. A shoe point and a box-bottom midpoint are different gait-dependent position proxies.
assumptions: 105x68 m pitch, 9.15 m circle. Feet at selected endpoints appear on the pitch; ground contact is not independently verified.
